# WakeelBano

> Career platform for Pakistani lawyers, starting in Karachi. It helps law students, fresh graduates and junior advocates find a chamber and mentor, paid drafting work and a legal job market covering all of Pakistan, paid drafting work, and free case law research guides. Junior lawyers use it free; chambers, firms and universities pay.

Key facts: founded 2026, based in Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan. Legal information only, not legal advice. No commission on client case referrals, and no lawyer rankings. Guidance is drawn from Pakistani statutes, bar council notifications and official court publications, with sources listed on every page.
